decisions.reason: The Abendbrotkäse was launched as the flagship of the cheese direction, but it has not appeared on the website since 2018, so the firm is giving it less promotion and the risk of dropping it is moderate.
A semi-hard cheese wheel is a basic, close-to-core item in an organic cheese range and costs little to keep, even though the website no longer highlights it.
Individual spicy variants may be trimmed after weak visibility in 2020 to 2021, but the line as a whole most likely stays in the range.
The mild creamy soft cheese is a mainstream product that suits broad retail demand, so it is probably kept despite less website presence.
The washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche item and faces the highest risk of retailer delisting, but it is not yet clear enough that it should be withdrawn.
